profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary: Chiara Orsini received the M.S. and Ph.D degrees in Computer Engineering both from the University of Pisa in 2009 and 2013 respectively. From 2013 to 2016, worked as a post-doctoral position at the Cooperative Association for the Internet Data Analysis (CAIDA), University of California San Diego (UCSD). From 2016 she holds a position a Software Developer Engineer, at Amazon.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description: I have been doing research on different projects guided by kc Claffy, Dmitri Krioukov, and Alberto Dainotti. My research interests include: analysis of the structural properties of the graph, synthetic graph generation, and network security.

positions.title: Internship @ CAIDA
positions.description: I am continuing my previous work on dk-graph under the supervision of Dr. Dmitri Krioukov.

positions.title: PhD student
positions.description:
I have been working as a PhD student at the Institute of Informatics and Telematics, CNR, Pisa and  at the Department of Information Engineering, University of Pisa. 

Curricula: Computer systems architectures

positions.description: Worked on dk-graphs @ CAIDA (The Cooperative Association for Internet Data Analysis) under the supervision of Dr. Dmitri Krioukov.

projects.title: Detecting and Characterizing Internet Traffic Interception based on BGP Hijacking
projects.description:
Working on the real-time (historical) detection of traffic interception events caused by BGP anomalies

http://bgpstream.caida.org/

projects.title: Detection and analysis of large-scale Internet infrastructure outages
projects.description: I am studying the characteristics of Internet outages caused by routing anomalies and I am developing tools for their detection. I am focusing on the analysis and processing of control-plane data (BGP) in realtime (bgpmon) or in pseudo-realtime (RIPE RIS or RouteViews).

publications.title: Evolution of the Internet k-Dense Structure
